language.description: A language tag according to https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/bcp/bcp47.txt to specify the language of the resource.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the resource which can be retrieved from the url.

row.description: A code list row. The object MUST contain a property for every non-optional column and MAY omit columns declared as optional. Every property name MUST match the ID of a defined column.

.+.description: The value. It must be valid with respect to the type and restrictions of the matching column.

anyOf.description: A null value. Only permitted if the matching column definition allows null values.
A numeric value. Only permitted if the matching column definition is `integer` or `number`.
A boolean value. Only permitted if the matching column definition is `boolean`.
A scalar string value. Only permitted if the matching column definition is `string`, `date`, `time`, `date-time`, or `enum` with a matching string member.
An embedded JSON object. Only permitted if the matching column definition is `document`.
A JSON array. For an `enum-set` column, every item MUST be a string matching a declared enumeration member. For a `document` column, the array represents the embedded JSON document.
A localized string value. Only permitted if the matching column definition is `string`. Each property name MUST be a valid BCP 47 language tag.

additionalProperties.description: The localized text for the language identified by the property name.

customExtension.description: Any JSON value used as a custom OpenCodeList extension.
